policy.telluric_note: Conservative analyst-defined bands, not a measured transmission mask. Passing does not prove freedom from weak tellurics, sky or unrelated absorption.
policy.rank: third-highest proxy CNR among eligible strong lines, then count; descending. Top 5 distinct sightlines; retain all rejection reasons.
policy.profile_diagnostics: Full fixed +/-250 km/s windows, then predeclared +/-100 km/s core diagnostic. No relative-velocity based rejection; no sub-km/s or cosmic-time inference from moment centroids.
